title: Wavelet covariances under fixed finite observations: dilation symmetry breaking and distinct endpoint limits
summary: For a centered homogeneous generalized Gaussian field with spectral weight $C|ω|^{-γ}$, we prove two-endpoint recovery of normalized posterior wavelet covariances under fixed finite admissible observations. Global dilation symmetry holds if and only if all observation functions vanish. The nonzero wavelet and the observation functions are real Schwartz functions with $M\geq1$ vanishing moments, with $C>0$ and $γ 0$, $1/2<p<M+1/2$, fixed finite noisy point observations yield distinct compact-uniform limits: the homogeneous $C|ω|^{-2p}$ kernel after multiplication by $λ^{-2p}$ at small scales,…
